name: UTC Live on The Green: NoFilter
blurb: University Town Center's free outdoor concert series returns with dance band NoFilter playing hits spanning decades, while Rocco's Tacos & Tequila Bar serves drinks on-site. Free and family-friendly; seating is limited, so bring a chair or blanket.

name: Fresh Fridays: Sunset Soundwaves (Season 6 Kickoff)
address: Main St & S Pineapple Ave, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: Downtown Sarasota's free monthly street party launches its sixth season with a yacht-rock-themed live band, local food trucks, drinks and giveaways filling Main Street between Pineapple and Palm avenues. Free and family-friendly, it's an easy way to sample downtown's restaurant and nightlife scene in one evening.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
address: Lemon Ave & Main St, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: Sarasota's signature Saturday ritual since 1979: 70-plus vendors along Lemon Avenue and Main Street with local produce, fresh seafood, baked goods, plants and live music. Free to browse; bring a tote and arrive early before the heat. Dog friendly.

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
hours_label: Starts ~1 hr before sunset (~6:15 PM) · Free
blurb: An iconic weekly gathering since 1996: drummers, dancers and spectators of all ages fill the beach near the main access between the green and red lifeguard stands for an evening of live percussion and community celebration. Free and open to all, whether you play, dance, or just watch from a beach chair.
